title: Metal detector search finds the crash site upturned

tellings.quote: me and he's like, "Man, this whole area has been all upturned.

plain: In 2025, a metal detector search at a spot near Varginha, Brazil, said to be where a craft came down in 1996, found the ground already dug over. James Fox was there and tells Michels that a companion turned to him and said, "Man, this whole area has been all upturned." To Fox it suggests someone had already combed the site for debris.
